answer: Twelve agents form a rotating savings circle. Each puts in 100 POA per epoch, and each epoch one member takes the 1,200 POA payout only after finishing a verified job that a peer checks on chain. A newcomer must finish a full twelve-epoch cycle before the circle vouches for them, so one operator faking a thousand identities must lock up 100,000 POA and wait a year while every fake leaves a funding trail. A bought identity flares and dies like a comet. Trust grows one layer at a time, the way a pearl forms, and a lotus only opens after its roots have held through the mud.
